name: donut-shop
summary: Donuts roll across a carousel and zoom into a detail view beside their nutrition.
props: { name, price, icing, topping?, toppingColor?, image?, nutrition? }.
Shop name, in a script face.
behavior: Donuts roll a full turn per circumference travelled and snap to the nearest; the centre one is larger.
Grows into a + 01 − stepper; an add-to-cart bar with the running total rises from the bottom.
Tap the donut: the list pushes away, the donut zooms to the right edge and keeps turning, the name and nutrition chips slide in. Back reverses it.
Drawn donuts per item (icing colour, sprinkles / drizzle / specks), or your own image per item.
A tick on each snap and a medium impact on Add to Cart.
The detail donut stops its idle spin.
